entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: Continued repricing of dollar political/geopolitical demand and Europe's energy outlook over coming weeks. Confirmation may support later resizing but is not an entry prerequisite. Election reporting alone does not prove peace or lower deficits.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: Realize through EURUSD appreciation toward the judgmental1.1356–1.1472 range. Review progress at1.1356; use subsequent shared evidence for any harvest, resize or exit. Re-underwrite by84days rather than indefinitely extending the thesis.

entry_rationale: PM accepts independently verified EUR payoff/volatility arithmetic but overrides the analysts' reject. An already-realized0.79% rally and the absence of a euro-specific residual do not disprove further broad-dollar repricing. Unknowns justify a small initial position before confirmation. The EUR exit lies within ordinary movement and can stop out a right broader thesis; that is accepted explicitly, not labeled low risk.
entry_thesis: Initial USD5m-equivalent EURUSD long on a discretionary view that post-election unwinding of geopolitical/political dollar demand can continue and cheaper energy can improve Europe's outlook. The trade expresses broad dollar weakness; EUR need not outperform all European peers. This is a conditional judgment, not a proven factor model or a request from Kevin to buy EUR.
